messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api-us-east detected sustained queue growth and GPU pool saturation. Autoscaler failing to provision new GPU nodes (error: QuotaExceeded). queued_requests=18,342; p95=4.3s; p99=12.1s. Potential customer impact. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/1764448888

jamie-oncall: on it — paging infra + sRE. grabbing dashboards and logs.

maya-sre: looking at provisioner logs: "Failed to allocate GPU instance: QuotaExceeded: gpu-quota 0/100". Autoscaler also hit configured max_instances=120 earlier. backlog workers blocked waiting for slots.

carlos-support: getting customer escalations: AcmeApp reporting 504s, Shoply reporting timeouts. One enterprise account ticketing now.

rachel-eng: Two quick mitigations we can apply immediately: 1) enable fallback model variant (gpt-small-quant) for hosted routes (~60% GPU mem reduction) 2) soft-throttle the top 5 noisy API keys. I can flip fallback if ops approves.

jamie-oncall: do fallback first. @liam-provisioner start evicting best-effort dev/non-prod pools to free GPUs.

liam-provisioner: kicking eviction job now. Command run: 
kubectl -n provisioner exec provisioner-0 -- /bin/sh -c "python /app/evict_low_priority.py --dry-run=false --age=10m"
Provisioner shows cloud API returning 429/QuotaExceeded on instance create. Opened cloud ticket CLD-987654.

devex-bot: Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-surge — follow steps 1-4 (fallback, evict, throttle, reroute).

rachel-eng: flipping fallback rollout:
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/route/update -d '{"route":"hosted-default","model_fallback":"gpt-small-quant"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
Response: 200 OK — rollout at 15% of traffic.

carlos-support: AcmeApp error rate down ~25% after initial fallback. :thumbsup:

maya-sre: autoscaler still failing to create new instances in us-east due to quota. Can we spill lower-priority traffic to eu-region for now?

tanya-pm: prioritize enterprise customers — move Enterprise plan keys to dedicated pools as a temporary override.

jamie-oncall: agreed. rachel, can you do an override to dedicated for enterprise keys?

rachel-eng: doing override now:
POST https://admin.redwood/api/route/override -> {"keys":["ent-001","ent-042"],"target":"dedicated-pool-1"}
Response: 202 Accepted — routing change in progress.

liam-provisioner: cloud quota increase request submitted (CLD-987654) with priority support. ETA ~2h if approved. Evictions freed ~10 GPUs so far. Metrics: queued_requests -> 8,243; p95 -> 1.8s; p99 -> 5.6s.

nora-ml: FYI fallback quantized model reduces latency/cost but expect some quality degradation on long-form completions — will spin up quick evals to monitor regressions.

jamie-oncall: setting severity SEV2. Good recovery direction. Follow-ups: quota escalation postmortem, consider permanent spillover policy and increase autoscaler headroom.

devex-bot: Incident page created: https://redwood/incidents/1764448888 (please add notes).

rachel-eng: rolling fallback to 50% now. Observability: p99 trending down steadily.

carlos-support: customer comms sent to AcmeApp and Shoply; both acknowledged and appreciate the update.

tanya-pm: opening follow-up ticket ENG-4821 for autoscaler behavior when cloud quotas block provisioning and for better preemptible strategies.

jamie-oncall: thanks team. If metrics hold for 30m we'll remove emergency throttles and update runbook with steps we executed. Handoff to night oncall in 2h. Leaving channel open for monitoring. :white_check_mark:
